anya: AM async — quick standup for deals + sec asks

What I did yesterday: demo + pricing walkthrough with Nova, got verbal OK on P0 terms, sent draft term sheet.
Blockers: Nova legal asked for HSM/KMS integration details and whether keywrap will add latency to inference path. Also need confirmation on Private deployment (VPC) ETA for their SOC team.
Today: follow-up with Nova legal, prep SOW + deploy checklist. Ping @security_sme @jason for HSM/KMS latency numbers.

mike: Yesterday: triaged CortexA followups, synced with infra about reserved capacity questions.
Blocker: waiting on security confirmation for HSM throughput. If HSM adds >20ms per request they want an offline signing flow instead.
Today: draft alternate architecture notes for offline signing + tradeoffs. Pinged product for cost numbers.

tara: Quick check — for Nova we promised an encryption-at-rest + KMS key wrap doc. I can attach the design doc once sec approves wording. Also need to know whether Dedicated supports customer-managed keys in our current alpha.

jason: Security SME here — quick answers:
- HSM signing latency (typical range): 1–8ms per operation depending on instance and network.
- Keywrap overhead: ~2–6ms for key unwrap on first request, then cached session tokens reduce it.
- Worst-case e2e add (with network + HSM): 12–25ms, but can be mitigated via prefix/KV caching or async signing for non-latency-critical tokens.

Snippet for Nova legal if you want to paste:```text
HSM_sign_ms ~= 1-8 ms
KMS_keywrap_first_request ~= 2-6 ms
Cached_session_signing ~= ~0.5-2 ms
Estimated_e2e_overhead ~= 12-25 ms (worst-case)
```

I can draft a one-pager with mitigations (caching, session tokens, offline signing) by EOD. @anya tag me for the SOW wording.

deploy-bot: Deployment status: private-deploy-alpha -> staging passed basic smoke tests, HSM integration tests queued (ETA ~3h). Logs: `deploy/alpha/hsm-int-test`

mike: Re: CRs — pinging @tara for the dedicated-config PR review (it's a small change to enable customer KMS key_id passthrough). Need review to unblock staging tests.

If we see >20ms e2e we present offline signing option. Will update thread after calls. :thumbsup:
